ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with a dominant low-intensity (black) background interrupted by localized high-intensity (white) circular regions; roughly 80% low-intensity to 20% high-intensity ratio on the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity (white) clusters are localized at the distal tips. Distinctive white circular rings and semi-circles are distributed semi-randomly across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes, overlaid on a solid black base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex angle approximately 45 degrees, showing significant depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely jagged topography with high-frequency, high-amplitude serrations. Notable large peaks and valleys are present on the distal third of both lobes, creating a non-linear, irregular boundary against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave sweep originating from the median notch, curving upward to narrow, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed constellations of circular and ring-shaped high-contrast pixel clusters (rosettes) across both lobes, with the highest density observed at the tips and trailing edges.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive field of circular white rings likely representing barnacle attachment scars; significant irregular notch-like variations in the trailing edge topography suggest multiple instances of minor physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'ocelli' or ring-like pigmentation pattern across the entirety of the dark ventral surface.
